When you change your bank details, Wix Payments has to re-verify your account. During that time your status goes back to **Accepting Payments**: you can still take payments, but **payouts are paused** until verification completes (normally up to 7 business days). Accumulated payouts are then released.

Since it's been a couple of weeks, please check:
- Your **name and date of birth** match your photo ID exactly.
- The **bank account number** is correct, and the **account holder name matches** the Wix Payments account owner (e.g. a personal account registered to "Lisa Harrison" will fail if the bank account is "Lisa's Cupcakes").
- The bank account can receive **EFT/ACH** transfers.
- Your address is physical (no PO boxes) with a utility bill from the last 6 months.

To review: **Accept Payments → Manage (Wix Payments) → Edit Account Details**, correct anything wrong and click **Resubmit**. You can also check **Payouts on Hold** for a failed-payout reason.

Because more than 7 business days have passed, I'm connecting you with a support agent to investigate your verification.

redirect_to_agent.reason: Bank detail verification has taken longer than the documented 7 business days; needs account investigation.

A gap at the bottom of the live desktop page usually appears when the page content is shorter than the page length. Try one of these:

1. **Adjust the page height:** in the editor, click the page body near the footer and drag the **Adjust Page Height** icon up to remove the space between your content and the footer. (If the page is covered in strips, pull the footer down first so you can click the page.)
2. **Resize the footer** to make it longer so it fills the space.
3. **Match the background:** change the page background color to match the footer so the gap blends in.
4. **Add content** to make the page longer.

If the gap is between a full-width element (like a stretched strip or menu) and other elements, click **Zoom out to 50%** in the top bar and move the elements to close the space.

Since it's published and not password-protected, check these next:

1. **Indexing is allowed:** **SEO** dashboard → **Go to SEO Settings** → make sure **Let search engines index your site** is on.
2. **No "noindex" tag:** a page with a "noindex" robots meta tag won't appear in results.
3. **Not members-only:** members-only pages, and a members-only or password-protected **homepage**, can't be crawled.
4. **Enough content:** pages with little or no content may be skipped. Aim for at least 250-400 words.
5. **Internal links:** link your pages to each other so search engines can find them.
6. **Submit your site:** complete the **Wix SEO Setup Checklist**, which submits your site to Google (connecting Google Search Console requires a Premium plan and a connected domain).

To check progress, search Google for **site:yourdomain.com**. Note that indexing time is set by the search engines and can take a while; not every page is guaranteed to be indexed.

The most common reason reordering in the collection doesn't change the live site is that a **dataset sort overrides it**.

To control the order from your collection:
1. Go to **CMS** → open the collection (and the view you want to use).
2. Either click **Sort → + Add a Sort**, or in the **Table** layout drag the **Reorder** icon next to items. (Manual drag reordering isn't released in all accounts yet.)
3. Click **Mirror on Site** and enable **Mirror item order on the site**.

Then check the **dataset** connected to your repeater or gallery: if it has its own **sort condition**, that sort wins over the mirrored order. Remove the dataset sort if you want the collection order to apply.

If these are Wix Stores products, reorder them in **Categories** in your dashboard instead.

You can cancel from your Premium Subscriptions page:

1. Go to **Premium Subscriptions** in your Wix account.
2. Click the **More Actions** icon next to the plan.
3. Click **Cancel Plan**.
4. Click **Cancel Now** to confirm (you'll be asked for feedback first).

Because you're within the **first 14 days**, the plan ends **immediately** and you're fully refunded automatically. It can take up to 20 business days to appear on your statement.

Note: canceling the site plan doesn't cancel domains, business email or app subscriptions; those must be canceled separately. Your site isn't deleted; it returns to the free version.

A secure (HTTPS) connection needs your SSL certificate to be active, which requires your domain to be properly connected. Check:

1. **DNS records:** go to **Domains** → **More Actions** next to your domain → **Manage DNS Records**, and confirm the default **A** and **CNAME** records are there. If you connected via name servers, make sure your domain host has the Wix name servers set.
2. **Wait for propagation:** a newly connected domain can take up to **48 hours**.
3. **HTTPS-only embedded code:** if you use HTML/embed elements, click **Edit Code** and make sure the code has no `http://` links, then publish.
4. **Your device:** older operating systems may not recognize modern SSL certificates. Update your OS, and use the latest version of a supported browser.
5. **Public networks** (schools, libraries) may block Wix servers.

If you still can't view your site over HTTPS, I can connect you with a support agent.

Payments go through a few stages before reaching your bank:

1. **Processing:** usually **2-5 business days** after your customer pays.
2. **Scheduled payout:** added to your next daily, weekly or monthly payout.
3. **Sent:** after it's sent, it takes **3-5 business days** to arrive (depending on the day of the week, currency and bank holidays).

Also check that:
- Your Wix Payments account is **verified** and its status is **Active** (payouts don't go out otherwise).
- Your available balance is at least **$1**.
- If it's your **first payout**, it's available on average **7 days** after your first payment.

Go to **Payouts** in your Wix Payments dashboard to see when your payout is or was sent. If a payout failed, make sure the bank account holder name matches your Wix Payments account and that the account can receive EFT/ACH transfers.

There isn't a hide option for the Quick Action Bar, but you have two choices:

**Remove the whole bar:** in the **mobile editor**, right-click the Quick Action Bar and select **Delete**. Note that this removes the details you entered for each action, so you'll need to add them again when you re-add the bar.

**Remove only unfinished actions:** select the bar → **Set Up Quick Actions** → hover over an action → **More actions** icon → **Remove**.

If you have Wix Chat installed, removing the bar doesn't remove Wix Chat from your mobile site; you'd need to delete it from the editor separately.

Copying a page between sites doesn't overwrite anything: the pasted page is always added as a **new main page**.

1. In the **copy** site's editor, click **Menus & Pages**.
2. Right-click the edited page and click **Copy**.
3. Open the **original** site's editor in the same browser.
4. Right-click anywhere and select **Paste** (or **Paste & Apply Site Theme**).
5. In the Pages panel, give the new page a distinct name and click **Done**.

Your original page stays as it is, so you can compare them and delete the old one later if you want.

Note: only regular pages copy. App pages (Stores, Bookings, etc.) and elements like Velo code, headers/footers, datasets and Wix Pro Gallery don't copy. Links on the page are redirected to the target site's home page.
